name: combined-annotator
description: Offline adaptive Chinese annotator and learning tools for Pinyin and Jyutping

scripts.start: npm run prepare:firefox && web-ext run --source-dir web-ext-artifacts/firefox-unpacked
scripts.test: node tests/engine.test.js && node tests/core.test.js && node tests/lexicon.test.js && node tests/browser-contract.test.js && node tests/stroke-data.test.js
scripts.build:firefox-review: node build-lexicon.js && node build-data.js && node build-extension.js --build-firefox
